items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Of course, because Dizzy played with him, and a lot of other good guys played with him.

ctx.x: And Cab Calloway. That’s a band I didn’t ask you about. Did that figure in your calculus at all?
Of course, because Dizzy played with him, and a lot of other good guys played with him.
So that’s a part of that time of the intersecting bands, and these guys jump from this band to that band.
